toast.hit-counter.reset.title: Hit Counter
command.hit-counter.stats.empty: No hit counts are currently registered.
disconnect.hit-counter.summary.title: Hit Counter session summary
config.hit-counter.title: Hit Counter
config.hit-counter.balance_position.tool: Choose where the hit balance appears relative to a player's username.
config.hit-counter.server_override.serve: Only servers saved on the Multiplayer screen can have an override.
config.hit-counter.server_override.add.t: Create an independent profile for the selected saved server, or edit its existing profile.
config.hit-counter.hit_source_filter_mod: Whitelist counts only selected sources; blacklist ignores selected sources.
config.hit-counter.count_unknown_hit_sou: When off, damage from sources that cannot be identified is ignored. The listed sources below are unaffected.
config.hit-counter.hit_source_group.mele: Select or clear melee attack, mace smash, and spear together.
config.hit-counter.hit_source_group.proj: Select or clear all projectile sources together.
config.hit-counter.hit_source_group.spec: Select or clear instant-damage potions, server magic, and Thorns together.
config.hit-counter.hit_source_group.expl: Select or clear both explosion sources together.
config.hit-counter.hit_source.player_att: Sword, axe, fist, and other regular close-range attacks.
config.hit-counter.hit_source.mace_smash: A falling attack with a mace.
config.hit-counter.hit_source.arrow.tool: Arrows fired by players, including tipped arrows.
Firework rockets that damage a player.
config.hit-counter.hit_source.instant_da: Splash and lingering Instant Damage potions. Poison and other damage-over-time effects are not player-attributed and are not counted.
config.hit-counter.hit_source.server_mag: Non-potion magic damage, including abilities reported as direct or indirect magic.
config.hit-counter.hit_source.player_exp: An explosion with a player credited as the attacker, such as TNT or end-crystal damage caused by a player.
An explosion without a directly credited player, or one a server reports generically.
config.hit-counter.enabled.tooltip: When disabled, hit counts are cleared and no new hits are tracked.
config.hit-counter.show_zero_balances.to: Show a 0 after two players balance their registered hits.
config.hit-counter.flashback_replays: Render hit balances in Flashback replays
config.hit-counter.flashback_replays.too: Records balances with Flashback and replays them above player nameplates. Balances already present when recording begins are included.
config.hit-counter.death_reset_mode.tool: Controls whose balances reset after a detected death. Opponent deaths clear only that opponent's balance; unrelated players are unaffected.
config.hit-counter.auto_reset_on_death.t: Use normal player death and respawn updates to reset balances.
config.hit-counter.auto_reset_on_spectat: Use a player entering spectator mode when a server does not send normal death or respawn updates.
config.hit-counter.auto_reset_inactive.t: Reset one player's balance after neither player has hit the other for the selected time.
config.hit-counter.inactivity_timeout.to: How long an individual balance can stay inactive before it resets.
toast.hit-counter.inactive_reset.title: Inactive balance reset
config.hit-counter.normal_hit_value.tool: How many hits a normal hit counts as.
config.hit-counter.weak_hit_value.toolti: How many hits an uncharged melee hit counts as.
config.hit-counter.critical_hit_value.to: How many hits a critical hit counts as.
config.hit-counter.color.tooltip: Choose the RGB hex color used for this count.
